title: TOGBench: Benchmarking and Improving Tiny-Object Generation Fidelity in Aerial Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.23840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advances in deep generative models now enable the synthesis of realistic imagery. However, aerial imagery is dominated by tiny objects, such as vehicles, ships, and aircraft, which occupy only a few pixels owing to the overhead, wide-area nature of aerial imaging. Existing generative models struggle substantially more with tiny objects than with larger ones. This limitation has been overlooked, as prior work on generative evaluation emphasizes prompt following or human preference rather than whether small objects are rendered faithfully. To address this gap, we introduce TOGBench, a quantitative, object-level benchmark for evaluating tiny-object generation fidelity in aerial imagery. We further propose two simple train-/inference-time techniques that improve the ability of layout-to-image generators to render small objects, raising their performance on TOGBench.

translated_title: TOGBench：面向航空影像中微小目标生成保真度的基准测试与改进
translated_abstract: 深度生成模型的进步如今已能够合成逼真的图像。然而，航空影像中充斥着微小目标，例如车辆、船舶和飞机，由于航空成像的俯视、广域特性，这些目标仅占据几个像素。现有的生成模型在处理微小目标时远比处理较大目标时困难。这一局限性一直被忽视，因为以往关于生成模型评估的工作更强调提示词遵循或人类偏好，而非小目标是否被忠实渲染。为填补这一空白，我们提出了TOGBench，一个用于评估航空影像中微小目标生成保真度的定量、目标级基准。我们进一步提出了两种简单的训练/推理阶段技术，以提升布局到图像生成器渲染小目标的能力，从而提高其在TOGBench上的表现。
tldr: 提出了首个面向航空影像微小目标生成保真度的定量目标级基准TOGBench，并配套两种简单的训练/推理阶段技术，显著提升了布局到图像生成器渲染小目标的能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce TOGBench, a quantitative object-level benchmark for evaluating tiny-object generation fidelity in aerial imagery, together with two simple train-/inference-time techniques that improve small-object rendering in layout-to-image generators.
